cover_headline: Six Researchers Win Infosys Prize 2026, Including Legal Scholar Gautam Bhatia
facts: Each laureate receives a gold medal, a citation and a prize purse of $100,000
Since 2024 the prize has focused on researchers under 40; this year the foundation received 222 applications
Three of this year's six laureates are based outside India, at institutions in the United States, Australia and Singapore

end.headline: Six Researchers Win Infosys Prize 2026, Including Legal Scholar Gautam Bhatia
end.line: Karthik Sastry, Swarun Kumar, Gautam Bhatia, Isha Jain, Riddhipratim Basu and Manoj Kumar Joshi each receive a gold medal, citation and $100,000.
